units.rawText: Today is a day off. I stroll about the Oasis some time after dinner, and come upon the Kurenoyume Shrine on the outskirts.
units.displayText: Today is a day off. I stroll about the Oasis some time after dinner, and come upon the Kurenoyume Shrine on the outskirts.

spans.text: Today is a day off. I stroll about the Oasis some time after dinner, and come upon the Kurenoyume Shrine on the outskirts.

units.rawText: I hear Nora's voice coming from within before I am halfway across the premises' width.
units.displayText: I hear Nora's voice coming from within before I am halfway across the premises' width.

spans.text: I hear Nora's voice coming from within before I am halfway across the premises' width.

units.rawText: I'm so, so done for. Zangyin's going to catch me again. She haunts me, like a spirit from beyond the grave.
units.displayText: I'm so, so done for. Zangyin's going to catch me again. She haunts me, like a spirit from beyond the grave.

spans.text: I'm so, so done for. Zangyin's going to catch me again. She haunts me, like a spirit from beyond the grave.

units.rawText: Kimie, I beseech thee, let me hide out in the shrine. There's no chance Zangyin will find me here, as simple-minded as she is.
units.displayText: Kimie, I beseech thee, let me hide out in the shrine. There's no chance Zangyin will find me here, as simple-minded as she is.

spans.text: Kimie, I beseech thee, let me hide out in the shrine. There's no chance Zangyin will find me here, as simple-minded as she is.

units.rawText: Hehe, rather than seek escape, you ought to settle on a premise for your new work. It would both satisfy the fans, and soothe your own mind.
units.displayText: Hehe, rather than seek escape, you ought to settle on a premise for your new work. It would both satisfy the fans, and soothe your own mind.

spans.text: Hehe, rather than seek escape, you ought to settle on a premise for your new work. It would both satisfy the fans, and soothe your own mind.

units.rawText: Inspiration doesn't simply come to me on the wind! I can't do it... I just can't...
units.displayText: Inspiration doesn't simply come to me on the wind! I can't do it... I just can't...

spans.text: Inspiration doesn't simply come to me on the wind! I can't do it... I just can't...

units.rawText: What about asking what the gods think?
units.displayText: What about asking what the gods think?

spans.text: What about asking what the gods think?

units.rawText: Professor?!
units.displayText: Professor?!

spans.text: Professor?!

units.rawText: Draw some sacred lots and ask the guys upstairs what they think. If they agree, we'll help hide you away.
units.displayText: Draw some sacred lots and ask the guys upstairs what they think. If they agree, we'll help hide you away.

spans.text: Draw some sacred lots and ask the guys upstairs what they think. If they agree, we'll help hide you away.

units.rawText: But if you draw a suekichi, be good and go back to work with Zangyin, okay? I happen to have something I want to ask of the gods as well. Hope you don't mind if I draw lots with you, Nora.
units.displayText: But if you draw a suekichi, be good and go back to work with Zangyin, okay? I happen to have something I want to ask of the gods as well. Hope you don't mind if I draw lots with you, Nora.

spans.text: But if you draw a suekichi, be good and go back to work with Zangyin, okay? I happen to have something I want to ask of the gods as well. Hope you don't mind if I draw lots with you, Nora.

units.rawText: Kimie quietly looks at me, her expression changing from one of surprise to an understanding smile. As I speak, Kimie produces a container for the lots.
units.displayText: Kimie quietly looks at me, her expression changing from one of surprise to an understanding smile. As I speak, Kimie produces a container for the lots.

spans.text: Kimie quietly looks at me, her expression changing from one of surprise to an understanding smile. As I speak, Kimie produces a container for the lots.

units.rawText: This world is fickle, and troubles abound. When we are uncertain, it is often good to seek divine guidance, lest our thoughts remain clouded.
units.displayText: This world is fickle, and troubles abound. When we are uncertain, it is often good to seek divine guidance, lest our thoughts remain clouded.

spans.text: This world is fickle, and troubles abound. When we are uncertain, it is often good to seek divine guidance, lest our thoughts remain clouded.

units.rawText: Kimie has prepared the sacred lots for you.
units.displayText: Kimie has prepared the sacred lots for you.

spans.text: Kimie has prepared the sacred lots for you.

units.rawText: I lightly shake my tube of lots, and Nora soon follows suit.
units.displayText: I lightly shake my tube of lots, and Nora soon follows suit.

spans.text: I lightly shake my tube of lots, and Nora soon follows suit.

units.rawText: Might you make a wish with us, Kimie? You've helped us realize so many wishes of ours. Surely, you have some of your own.
units.displayText: Might you make a wish with us, Kimie? You've helped us realize so many wishes of ours. Surely, you have some of your own.

spans.text: Might you make a wish with us, Kimie? You've helped us realize so many wishes of ours. Surely, you have some of your own.

units.rawText: Kimie's wishes?
units.displayText: Kimie's wishes?

spans.text: Kimie's wishes?

units.rawText: She thinks back to when the figure before her visited the shrine, before the autumn festival. An outreached hand as she lay exhausted, leading her out of a bog of stagnation.
units.displayText: She thinks back to when the figure before her visited the shrine, before the autumn festival. An outreached hand as she lay exhausted, leading her out of a bog of stagnation.

spans.text: She thinks back to when the figure before her visited the shrine, before the autumn festival. An outreached hand as she lay exhausted, leading her out of a bog of stagnation.

units.rawText: Kami-sama...
units.displayText: Kami-sama...

spans.text: Kami-sama...

units.rawText: Calling for me?
units.displayText: Calling for me?

spans.text: Calling for me?

units.rawText: Eh?? Esteemed Professor...
units.displayText: Eh?? Esteemed Professor...

spans.text: Eh?? Esteemed Professor...

units.rawText: Haha, no need to be so courtly. Just Professor is fine.
units.displayText: Haha, no need to be so courtly. Just Professor is fine.

spans.text: Haha, no need to be so courtly. Just Professor is fine.

units.rawText: You're finally awake, Kimie. You'll catch a cold, sleeping outside at this time of autumn.
units.displayText: You're finally awake, Kimie. You'll catch a cold, sleeping outside at this time of autumn.

spans.text: You're finally awake, Kimie. You'll catch a cold, sleeping outside at this time of autumn.

units.rawText: Go rest inside if you're so tired.
units.displayText: Go rest inside if you're so tired.

spans.text: Go rest inside if you're so tired.

units.rawText: Erudite in speech, a most personable body temperature, and a most soothing smile. All seemingly a blessing bestowed upon her by the divinities in those autumn days.
units.displayText: Erudite in speech, a most personable body temperature, and a most soothing smile. All seemingly a blessing bestowed upon her by the divinities in those autumn days.

spans.text: Erudite in speech, a most personable body temperature, and a most soothing smile. All seemingly a blessing bestowed upon her by the divinities in those autumn days.

units.rawText: She keeps in mind this boon with her entire being, and thus further hopes sprouted. As reminded by the one who holds her heart, she seems to have glimpsed into a side of her that should not belong to a miko. A flustered sliver mingles with her embarrassment.
units.displayText: She keeps in mind this boon with her entire being, and thus further hopes sprouted. As reminded by the one who holds her heart, she seems to have glimpsed into a side of her that should not belong to a miko. A flustered sliver mingles with her embarrassment.

units.rawText: Could you tell me what it is?

spans.text: Could you tell me what it is?

units.rawText: K-Kimie...
units.displayText: K-Kimie...

spans.text: K-Kimie...

units.rawText: Professor, wishes stop being magical if you say them out loud. We're starting!
units.displayText: Professor, wishes stop being magical if you say them out loud. We're starting!

spans.text: Professor, wishes stop being magical if you say them out loud. We're starting!

units.displayText: Kimie calms her wandering thoughts, giving her container a light shake.

spans.text: Kimie calms her wandering thoughts, giving her container a light shake.

units.rawText: Patter!
units.displayText: Patter!

spans.text: Patter!

units.displayText: The lots fall onto the table. The girl picks them up, noting our numbers and retrieving the corresponding results.

units.rawText: Ah... suekichi! Aw, crap...
units.displayText: Ah... suekichi! Aw, crap...

spans.text: Ah... suekichi! Aw, crap...

units.rawText: What about you two? Lemme see... eh? Both daikichi?!
units.displayText: What about you two? Lemme see... eh? Both daikichi?!

spans.text: What about you two? Lemme see... eh? Both daikichi?!

units.rawText: And these two bylines... are the exact same.
units.displayText: And these two bylines... are the exact same.

spans.text: And these two bylines... are the exact same.

units.rawText: Two tidy pieces of paper, both imprinted with the same line—"Sakura strings, binding passions. Two hearts, together content."
units.displayText: Two tidy pieces of paper, both imprinted with the same line—"Sakura strings, binding passions. Two hearts, together content."

spans.text: Two tidy pieces of paper, both imprinted with the same line—"Sakura strings, binding passions. Two hearts, together content."

units.rawText: I sneakily gaze at Kimie. A shade of red had crept onto her face at some point in time. Could these bylines be guidance, as if the gods had looked into our thoughts?
units.displayText: I sneakily gaze at Kimie. A shade of red had crept onto her face at some point in time. Could these bylines be guidance, as if the gods had looked into our thoughts?

spans.text: I sneakily gaze at Kimie. A shade of red had crept onto her face at some point in time. Could these bylines be guidance, as if the gods had looked into our thoughts?

units.rawText: ...Two hearts... together content...
units.displayText: ...Two hearts... together content...

spans.text: ...Two hearts... together content...

units.rawText: Hm? ...Oh! I see, I see now.
units.displayText: Hm? ...Oh! I see, I see now.

spans.text: Hm? ...Oh! I see, I see now.

units.rawText: (Cough) I've got some matters to attend to. No need to accompany me out.
units.displayText: (Cough) I've got some matters to attend to. No need to accompany me out.

spans.text: (Cough) I've got some matters to attend to. No need to accompany me out.

units.rawText: Nora swiftly departs with a wave of her hand, though not forgetting to blink at me a few times.
units.displayText: Nora swiftly departs with a wave of her hand, though not forgetting to blink at me a few times.

spans.text: Nora swiftly departs with a wave of her hand, though not forgetting to blink at me a few times.

units.rawText: Silence claims the shrine once more.
units.displayText: Silence claims the shrine once more.

spans.text: Silence claims the shrine once more.

units.rawText: ...You should take your time to rest up after a day's work. We should be grateful for how leisurely the past days have been. When summer rolls around, I fear the shrine will be bustling like a Sunday market again.
units.displayText: ...You should take your time to rest up after a day's work. We should be grateful for how leisurely the past days have been. When summer rolls around, I fear the shrine will be bustling like a Sunday market again.

spans.text: ...You should take your time to rest up after a day's work. We should be grateful for how leisurely the past days have been. When summer rolls around, I fear the shrine will be bustling like a Sunday market again.

units.rawText: Kimie will make proper preparations. You will not be disappointed, Professor.
units.displayText: Kimie will make proper preparations. You will not be disappointed, Professor.

spans.text: Kimie will make proper preparations. You will not be disappointed, Professor.

units.rawText: See, you're always like this. All aloof and unconcerned with worldly matters on the outside, but you care about those around you more than anyone else.
units.displayText: See, you're always like this. All aloof and unconcerned with worldly matters on the outside, but you care about those around you more than anyone else.

spans.text: See, you're always like this. All aloof and unconcerned with worldly matters on the outside, but you care about those around you more than anyone else.

units.rawText: With how gently you heal others, you must be a blessing on the Oasis from above.
units.displayText: With how gently you heal others, you must be a blessing on the Oasis from above.

spans.text: With how gently you heal others, you must be a blessing on the Oasis from above.

units.rawText: Or perhaps... not just on the Oasis, but on me as well.
units.displayText: Or perhaps... not just on the Oasis, but on me as well.

spans.text: Or perhaps... not just on the Oasis, but on me as well.

units.rawText: Kimie stops and stares at me, lowering her head with embarrassment a mere moment later.
units.displayText: Kimie stops and stares at me, lowering her head with embarrassment a mere moment later.

spans.text: Kimie stops and stares at me, lowering her head with embarrassment a mere moment later.

units.rawText: P-Professor...
units.displayText: P-Professor...

spans.text: P-Professor...

units.rawText: What's on your mind?
units.displayText: What's on your mind?

spans.text: What's on your mind?

units.rawText: T-Today really has been special. To draw the same byline as you, Professor...
units.displayText: T-Today really has been special. To draw the same byline as you, Professor...

spans.text: T-Today really has been special. To draw the same byline as you, Professor...

units.rawText: Yeah, though I do wonder what those words mean? Sakura strings, binding passions. Two hearts, together content.
units.displayText: Yeah, though I do wonder what those words mean? Sakura strings, binding passions. Two hearts, together content.

spans.text: Yeah, though I do wonder what those words mean? Sakura strings, binding passions. Two hearts, together content.

units.rawText: ...Pure sentiments of love from the heart, taking root many moons ago. When the two find happiness together, the clouds and gloom will part for their joyous faces.
units.displayText: ...Pure sentiments of love from the heart, taking root many moons ago. When the two find happiness together, the clouds and gloom will part for their joyous faces.

spans.text: ...Pure sentiments of love from the heart, taking root many moons ago. When the two find happiness together, the clouds and gloom will part for their joyous faces.

units.rawText: Thus spake the gods.
units.displayText: Thus spake the gods.

spans.text: Thus spake the gods.

units.rawText: But the one I have eyes for sees not my petition, and hears not my words. Kimie, could you help me with such troubles?
units.displayText: But the one I have eyes for sees not my petition, and hears not my words. Kimie, could you help me with such troubles?

spans.text: But the one I have eyes for sees not my petition, and hears not my words. Kimie, could you help me with such troubles?

units.rawText: I do my best impression of a troubled lovebird.
units.displayText: I do my best impression of a troubled lovebird.

spans.text: I do my best impression of a troubled lovebird.

units.rawText: E-Eh?
units.displayText: E-Eh?

spans.text: E-Eh?

units.rawText: Professor, you mean...
units.displayText: Professor, you mean...

spans.text: Professor, you mean...

units.rawText: Seeing Kimie flush with red, I put away my teasing smile, sincerely extending my hands.
units.displayText: Seeing Kimie flush with red, I put away my teasing smile, sincerely extending my hands.

spans.text: Seeing Kimie flush with red, I put away my teasing smile, sincerely extending my hands.

units.rawText: I would treasure this blessing bestowed upon me, and swear an eternal oath with you, Kimie.
units.displayText: I would treasure this blessing bestowed upon me, and swear an eternal oath with you, Kimie.

spans.text: I would treasure this blessing bestowed upon me, and swear an eternal oath with you, Kimie.

units.rawText: Would you wish for the same, Kimie?
units.displayText: Would you wish for the same, Kimie?

spans.text: Would you wish for the same, Kimie?

units.rawText: She looks deeply into me as starlight stirs in her eyes.
units.displayText: She looks deeply into me as starlight stirs in her eyes.

spans.text: She looks deeply into me as starlight stirs in her eyes.

units.rawText: Can Kimie really? There are so many Dolls always around you, Professor...
units.displayText: Can Kimie really? There are so many Dolls always around you, Professor...

spans.text: Can Kimie really? There are so many Dolls always around you, Professor...

units.rawText: An oath is a promise to be by someone's side for a lifetime. You've been with me at the Oasis all this time, trusting and consoling me unconditionally. I have no right to simply disregard that.
units.displayText: An oath is a promise to be by someone's side for a lifetime. You've been with me at the Oasis all this time, trusting and consoling me unconditionally. I have no right to simply disregard that.

spans.text: An oath is a promise to be by someone's side for a lifetime. You've been with me at the Oasis all this time, trusting and consoling me unconditionally. I have no right to simply disregard that.

units.rawText: So please, Miss Miko, swear this oath with me...
units.displayText: So please, Miss Miko, swear this oath with me...

spans.text: So please, Miss Miko, swear this oath with me...

units.rawText: Will you, Kimie?
units.displayText: Will you, Kimie?

spans.text: Will you, Kimie?

units.rawText: ...I... When Kimie was lost, it was you who gave me counsel so I could be free again, Professor.
units.displayText: ...I... When Kimie was lost, it was you who gave me counsel so I could be free again, Professor.

spans.text: ...I... When Kimie was lost, it was you who gave me counsel so I could be free again, Professor.

units.rawText: Kimie has few other fortes. To think that you would ask me to swear an oath with you in a such a state, Professor, I am bewildered...
units.displayText: Kimie has few other fortes. To think that you would ask me to swear an oath with you in a such a state, Professor, I am bewildered...

spans.text: Kimie has few other fortes. To think that you would ask me to swear an oath with you in a such a state, Professor, I am bewildered...

units.rawText: But Kimie does not want to lose this opportunity. Because it is you, Professor.
units.displayText: But Kimie does not want to lose this opportunity. Because it is you, Professor.

spans.text: But Kimie does not want to lose this opportunity. Because it is you, Professor.

units.rawText: Kimie is willing. Absolutely.
units.displayText: Kimie is willing. Absolutely.

spans.text: Kimie is willing. Absolutely.

units.rawText: She hurriedly takes my hand in hers. I do not hesitate, clasping her hand tightly and holding her close.
units.displayText: She hurriedly takes my hand in hers. I do not hesitate, clasping her hand tightly and holding her close.

spans.text: She hurriedly takes my hand in hers. I do not hesitate, clasping her hand tightly and holding her close.

units.rawText: Miko who serves the gods, stay your gaze on me, if you would.
units.displayText: Miko who serves the gods, stay your gaze on me, if you would.

spans.text: Miko who serves the gods, stay your gaze on me, if you would.

units.rawText: Kimie has eyes only for you right now, Professor.
units.displayText: Kimie has eyes only for you right now, Professor.

spans.text: Kimie has eyes only for you right now, Professor.

units.rawText: As Kimie suggested, we hold our oath ceremony at the Kurenoyume Shrine.
units.displayText: As Kimie suggested, we hold our oath ceremony at the Kurenoyume Shrine.

spans.text: As Kimie suggested, we hold our oath ceremony at the Kurenoyume Shrine.

units.rawText: Changing into proper garb in the morning, I arrive at the shrine as planned. She awaits me outside, clad in a brilliant white contrasting the myriad shapes and colors in the distance.
units.displayText: Changing into proper garb in the morning, I arrive at the shrine as planned. She awaits me outside, clad in a brilliant white contrasting the myriad shapes and colors in the distance.

spans.text: Changing into proper garb in the morning, I arrive at the shrine as planned. She awaits me outside, clad in a brilliant white contrasting the myriad shapes and colors in the distance.

units.rawText: She radiates a heavenly luster with a red parasol in hand, undoubtedly the most stunning existence in this realm of sakura and snow.
units.displayText: She radiates a heavenly luster with a red parasol in hand, undoubtedly the most stunning existence in this realm of sakura and snow.

spans.text: She radiates a heavenly luster with a red parasol in hand, undoubtedly the most stunning existence in this realm of sakura and snow.

units.rawText: The cloud is not quite reality, and I'm afraid the ritual may not be so well reproduced. I hope you don't mind so much, Kimie.
units.displayText: The cloud is not quite reality, and I'm afraid the ritual may not be so well reproduced. I hope you don't mind so much, Kimie.

spans.text: The cloud is not quite reality, and I'm afraid the ritual may not be so well reproduced. I hope you don't mind so much, Kimie.

units.rawText: Kimie is already overjoyed that you would endeavor to hold a ceremony in the shinzen style, Professor.
units.displayText: Kimie is already overjoyed that you would endeavor to hold a ceremony in the shinzen style, Professor.

spans.text: Kimie is already overjoyed that you would endeavor to hold a ceremony in the shinzen style, Professor.

units.rawText: After offering prayers and partake in san-san-kudo, I read my words of commitment. Kimie adds her name at the end, vowing to bind her heart with mine.
units.displayText: After offering prayers and partake in san-san-kudo, I read my words of commitment. Kimie adds her name at the end, vowing to bind her heart with mine.

spans.text: After offering prayers and partake in san-san-kudo, I read my words of commitment. Kimie adds her name at the end, vowing to bind her heart with mine.

units.rawText: We exchange rings, and make offerings to the gods.
units.displayText: We exchange rings, and make offerings to the gods.

spans.text: We exchange rings, and make offerings to the gods.

units.rawText: Thus our vows are complete.
units.displayText: Thus our vows are complete.

spans.text: Thus our vows are complete.

units.rawText: Yes.
units.displayText: Yes.

spans.text: Yes.

units.rawText: We prepare to return to the Oasis's inner layers with her hand in mine, but an incident comes our way surprisingly quickly.
units.displayText: We prepare to return to the Oasis's inner layers with her hand in mine, but an incident comes our way surprisingly quickly.

spans.text: We prepare to return to the Oasis's inner layers with her hand in mine, but an incident comes our way surprisingly quickly.

units.displayText: A string on one of Kimie's clogs snaps, and she topples. Thankfully I react quickly, seizing her waist and steadying her body.

spans.text: A string on one of Kimie's clogs snaps, and she topples. Thankfully I react quickly, seizing her waist and steadying her body.

units.rawText: Ahh!
units.displayText: Ahh!

spans.text: Ahh!

units.rawText: The string... br...
units.displayText: The string... br...

spans.text: The string... br...

units.rawText: It is frowned upon to say words such as "broken" and "cut". She swallows the words she intended to speak, worry on her countenance.
units.displayText: It is frowned upon to say words such as "broken" and "cut". She swallows the words she intended to speak, worry on her countenance.

spans.text: It is frowned upon to say words such as "broken" and "cut". She swallows the words she intended to speak, worry on her countenance.

units.rawText: These are not good omens.
units.displayText: These are not good omens.

spans.text: These are not good omens.

units.rawText: Hehe, devotion comes from the heart, not our worldly circumstances. You told me this before, Kimie. Where is this fluster coming from?
units.displayText: Hehe, devotion comes from the heart, not our worldly circumstances. You told me this before, Kimie. Where is this fluster coming from?

spans.text: Hehe, devotion comes from the heart, not our worldly circumstances. You told me this before, Kimie. Where is this fluster coming from?

units.rawText: Professor...
units.displayText: Professor...

spans.text: Professor...

units.rawText: How can a single pair of shoes be enough to make you question it all?
units.displayText: How can a single pair of shoes be enough to make you question it all?

spans.text: How can a single pair of shoes be enough to make you question it all?

units.rawText: I simply scoop her up by the waist.
units.displayText: I simply scoop her up by the waist.

units.rawText: Professor?! Professor...
units.displayText: Professor?! Professor...

spans.text: Professor?! Professor...

units.rawText: Are you going to turn me down, Kimie?
units.displayText: Are you going to turn me down, Kimie?

spans.text: Are you going to turn me down, Kimie?

units.rawText: N-no... it's just that we are still before the gods...
units.displayText: N-no... it's just that we are still before the gods...

spans.text: N-no... it's just that we are still before the gods...

units.rawText: I lower my head, snuggling up to her pink-red face. Her voice grows quieter and quieter as I look at her until she digs her head into my chest, her muffled articulations unbelievably cute.
units.displayText: I lower my head, snuggling up to her pink-red face. Her voice grows quieter and quieter as I look at her until she digs her head into my chest, her muffled articulations unbelievably cute.

units.displayText: Professor...

spans.text: Professor...

units.rawText: A pious believer holds another type of desire for an emissary of the gods. Speak your wish, Miss Miko.
units.displayText: A pious believer holds another type of desire for an emissary of the gods. Speak your wish, Miss Miko.

spans.text: A pious believer holds another type of desire for an emissary of the gods. Speak your wish, Miss Miko.

units.rawText: ...Kimie is worried...
units.displayText: ...Kimie is worried...

spans.text: ...Kimie is worried...

units.rawText: Why?
units.displayText: Why?

spans.text: Why?

units.rawText: Kimie knows that such acts sully the shrine's sanctity, and is looked down upon by the gods. But even so, Kimie cannot suppress the part of her that desires to be close to you.
units.displayText: Kimie knows that such acts sully the shrine's sanctity, and is looked down upon by the gods. But even so, Kimie cannot suppress the part of her that desires to be close to you.

spans.text: Kimie knows that such acts sully the shrine's sanctity, and is looked down upon by the gods. But even so, Kimie cannot suppress the part of her that desires to be close to you.

units.rawText: The gods have seen us take our vows. They would surely wish for us to support each other, with love in our hearts.
units.displayText: The gods have seen us take our vows. They would surely wish for us to support each other, with love in our hearts.

spans.text: The gods have seen us take our vows. They would surely wish for us to support each other, with love in our hearts.

units.rawText: Perhaps this is the first trial they have set for us.
units.displayText: Perhaps this is the first trial they have set for us.

spans.text: Perhaps this is the first trial they have set for us.

units.rawText: Though if you mind so much, let's have a change of scenery.
units.displayText: Though if you mind so much, let's have a change of scenery.

spans.text: Though if you mind so much, let's have a change of scenery.

units.rawText: I... it's fine, Professor.
units.displayText: I... it's fine, Professor.

spans.text: I... it's fine, Professor.

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: Here will do.
units.displayText: Here will do.

spans.text: Here will do.

units.rawText: Eh?!
units.displayText: Eh?!

spans.text: Eh?!

units.rawText: A great gust blows through, scattering sakura petals like diffused snow. Her hood drifts away upon the wind like the petals, freeing her raven locks. They freely fall onto my hands, entwining around my fingertips.
units.displayText: A great gust blows through, scattering sakura petals like diffused snow. Her hood drifts away upon the wind like the petals, freeing her raven locks. They freely fall onto my hands, entwining around my fingertips.

spans.text: A great gust blows through, scattering sakura petals like diffused snow. Her hood drifts away upon the wind like the petals, freeing her raven locks. They freely fall onto my hands, entwining around my fingertips.

units.rawText: She rises slightly in my embrace, her two arms around my neck. She gently pecks at my face, so softly one might mistake it for the touch of a falling petal.
units.displayText: She rises slightly in my embrace, her two arms around my neck. She gently pecks at my face, so softly one might mistake it for the touch of a falling petal.

spans.text: She rises slightly in my embrace, her two arms around my neck. She gently pecks at my face, so softly one might mistake it for the touch of a falling petal.

units.rawText: The sprinkled sakura forms a misty veil, placing a divide between us and the gods that resided yonder.
units.displayText: The sprinkled sakura forms a misty veil, placing a divide between us and the gods that resided yonder.

spans.text: The sprinkled sakura forms a misty veil, placing a divide between us and the gods that resided yonder.

units.rawText: When we met, I mistook you for a god. To think of it now, perhaps it was no fallacy of chance...
units.displayText: When we met, I mistook you for a god. To think of it now, perhaps it was no fallacy of chance...

spans.text: When we met, I mistook you for a god. To think of it now, perhaps it was no fallacy of chance...

units.rawText: Kimie beseeches countless deities to fulfil everyone's wishes. Yet Kimie's own wishes, only one god can fulfil.
units.displayText: Kimie beseeches countless deities to fulfil everyone's wishes. Yet Kimie's own wishes, only one god can fulfil.

spans.text: Kimie beseeches countless deities to fulfil everyone's wishes. Yet Kimie's own wishes, only one god can fulfil.

units.rawText: You.
units.displayText: You.

spans.text: You.

units.rawText: If pure white is the color of purity, then implication must be the color of the oath-holder.
units.displayText: If pure white is the color of purity, then implication must be the color of the oath-holder.

spans.text: If pure white is the color of purity, then implication must be the color of the oath-holder.

units.rawText: Kimie shall accompany you forever more, and your figure shall be in my every memory.
units.displayText: Kimie shall accompany you forever more, and your figure shall be in my every memory.

spans.text: Kimie shall accompany you forever more, and your figure shall be in my every memory.

units.rawText: Every part of her emanates sincerity, from her captivated and enamored eyes to her hopelessly romantic words.
units.displayText: Every part of her emanates sincerity, from her captivated and enamored eyes to her hopelessly romantic words.

spans.text: Every part of her emanates sincerity, from her captivated and enamored eyes to her hopelessly romantic words.

units.rawText: The petals settle into a pink-red carpet beneath us. I lay her down upon the ground, the sky her cover and earth her bedding. I warm her with my embrace.
units.displayText: The petals settle into a pink-red carpet beneath us. I lay her down upon the ground, the sky her cover and earth her bedding. I warm her with my embrace.

spans.text: The petals settle into a pink-red carpet beneath us. I lay her down upon the ground, the sky her cover and earth her bedding. I warm her with my embrace.

units.rawText: If some call a person who bestows upon them healing a god out of gratitude, then what is stopping you from being my goddess?
units.displayText: If some call a person who bestows upon them healing a god out of gratitude, then what is stopping you from being my goddess?

spans.text: If some call a person who bestows upon them healing a god out of gratitude, then what is stopping you from being my goddess?

units.rawText: I hope the goddess will forgive this sacrilegious act of mine...
units.displayText: I hope the goddess will forgive this sacrilegious act of mine...

spans.text: I hope the goddess will forgive this sacrilegious act of mine...

units.rawText: Don't say such things, Professor... Kimie is willing... to have this body be proof of our oath...
units.displayText: Don't say such things, Professor... Kimie is willing... to have this body be proof of our oath...

spans.text: Don't say such things, Professor... Kimie is willing... to have this body be proof of our oath...

units.rawText: A slip of paper comes drifting upon the wind, slowly landing on the shrine's shinboku after making a few circles.
units.displayText: A slip of paper comes drifting upon the wind, slowly landing on the shrine's shinboku after making a few circles.

spans.text: A slip of paper comes drifting upon the wind, slowly landing on the shrine's shinboku after making a few circles.

units.rawText: Upon it is gracefully written—"Sakura strings, binding passions. Two hearts, together content."
units.displayText: Upon it is gracefully written—"Sakura strings, binding passions. Two hearts, together content."

spans.text: Upon it is gracefully written—"Sakura strings, binding passions. Two hearts, together content."

units.rawText: Sakura petals fall like rain, this spring never-ending.
units.displayText: Sakura petals fall like rain, this spring never-ending.

spans.text: Sakura petals fall like rain, this spring never-ending.

units.rawText: No doubt, the ones who drew their lots here today have had their wishes answered...
units.displayText: No doubt, the ones who drew their lots here today have had their wishes answered...

spans.text: No doubt, the ones who drew their lots here today have had their wishes answered...
